annotations.title: Find a company's or project's tenements and drillholes

description: Use when the user names a company or project and wants what it holds in Western Australia: its tenements, drillholes and WAMEX reports. A company groups its legal names ("Northern Star (KLV) Pty Ltd", "Northern Star Resources Ltd", ...) under one key, joint ventures counting for each party. Returns, closest name match first, each company's or project's key, name, counts (tenements and live ones, drillholes, reports), extent (bbox), the registered names it stands for, and a map link drawing its holdings. Pass the key to find_drillholes or make_map_link.

q.description: A company or project name, or part of one (3+ characters).
